title.narrative: Harvest Finance: Roadmap to unlock capital for Ivorian agri-preneurs

description.narrative: In Côte d'Ivoire, agribusiness is a key economic sector, yet many entrepreneurs struggle to secure the financing needed to scale their businesses. Existing financial initiatives provide opportunities, but agripreneurs often lack the knowledge, financial literacy, and tools to successfully identify and access follow-up funding. This project directly addresses these challenges by equipping Ivorian micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises (MSEs) and startups in agriculture with practical financial knowledge and resources. Implemented by Comoé Capital, the project aims to improve investment readiness and financial inclusion through three key interventions:1. A 'How to Access Finance' roadmap – a step-by-step guide for entrepreneurs on securing investment.2. A financial toolkit – including templates, guidelines, and resources to strengthen financial planning.3. A digital training course – providing accessible learning materials via e-learning, video, or podcast formats, followed with some additional handholding support.By providing clarity on how to navigate the financial landscape and demystifying the investment process, this project will strengthen the agribusiness ecosystem and empower local entrepreneurs to access financing opportunities, strengthening the Netherlands' commitment to foster sustainable economic growth.Moreover, this initiative will build on and align with the running Orange Corners Innovation Fund (OCIF) programme, which is already supporting young entrepreneurs in providing access to their first capital. The outcomes of this project are to be integrated within this programme.
